purpose: Freeze the current analysis and resolve assets on HPC before regenerating.
actions: Map local and historical scratch paths to HPC. Check symlink targets and availability before downloads or new jobs.
Inventory the 37 benchmark inputs plus Visium HD and LR-Split-seq analyses and matched short-read/bulk references; record native/reconstructed state and parent library identities.
Record run-specific software pins, source hashes, count units, approved current panels, superseded analyses and pending decisions. Preserve the cloned baseline and use a new working branch.
Use the copied accession audits; controlled Engblom reads need authorized HPC access and release eligibility must be recorded.
validation: Every current panel has an experiment ID and inputs; every input has a resolved asset status.
All 37 benchmark IDs are retained; Figure 8 is retired only from the current build; 7E is pending.
No absence claim extends beyond checked locations; no unverified bytes are marked content-validated.
decision_needed: No new scope confirmation required; collect unresolved scientific choices D01-D08 without blocking independent inventory.
public_outputs: public asset registry and acquisition instructions
availability_notes: The complete accession and local provenance notes are in context/. Some large files have only a local metadata check; HPC must verify content before reuse.

purpose: Index and reconcile the legacy public Zenodo workspaces.
actions: Download the four public RData files listed in the captured API and verify Zenodo MD5 plus repository SHA-256.
Load each workspace into its own empty R environment and export names, classes, dimensions, key fields and the minimum portable objects required by each retained current panel.
Map old Figures 2-5 objects to current figures and separate removed clonotype material. Keep historical archives unchanged.
Inspect DOI and related identifier metadata; document why the actual preprint DOI conflicts with the README reserved Zenodo DOI claim.
validation: All downloaded hashes checked; failures investigated rather than ignored.
Object index explicitly distinguishes loaded contents from README descriptions.
No old workspace is treated as proof that a current raw run produced its contents.
decision_needed: Final DOI/record publication changes belong to release review; no decision is needed for public download and inspection.
public_outputs: workspace object indexes and export schemas
availability_notes: Public API verified 2026-10-23; four files total 6,194,634,418 bytes. Contents were not downloaded for the local audit.

purpose: Recover executable provenance and lock the environments for each selected workflow.
actions: Collect run-specific RAD source/commit/binary hashes, BLAZE packages and settings, Flexiplex diagnostic source/patch, quality generator/model files and third-party analysis dependencies.
Preserve historical command interfaces; do not substitute current main/dev or one version across all figures.
Vendor current helper scripts and declared resources into the working repository or a versioned dependency. Add immutable environment/container definitions and session information.
Determine hardware, scheduler, thread and memory needs from retained logs, then use a small pilot where needed. Do not copy historical scheduler job dependencies.
validation: Each executed stage resolves to code revision, patch and binary/container hash.
Modified Flexiplex raw-barcode diagnostics are reproducible with source-truth injection disabled.
Historical seed semantics documented; deferred pathname-independent change not silently applied.
Environment creation and small tool smoke tests pass on HPC.
decision_needed: Changing the selected tool version or ScTagger generator is a separately reviewed new analysis; recovery of existing versions can proceed.
availability_notes: The current README version table is insufficient and partly inconsistent with revised experiments. Code snapshots aid transport but do not themselves form a complete environment.

purpose: Build the current Figures 1-7 stage graph with resumable, validated checkpoints.
actions: Import selected figure workflows and wire their actual outputs into parsing, metrics, statistics and rendering.
Implement path configuration, explicit dependencies, hash-based invalidation and atomic checkpoint promotion.
Separate cached rendering requirements from raw-run requirements. Missing expected outputs must fail, not warn and continue.
Preserve old release entry points separately. Exclude removed Figure 8 from the current default build.
Define all newly proposed checkpoint files and entry points as implementation deliverables; do not claim they already exist.
validation: Current completed panels are discoverable and resolve to explicit upstream assets.
A full run cannot use an unrelated fixed RData workspace after generating new demux output.
A small changed-input test invalidates dependent stages only.
Missing outputs/schema failures return a nonzero status.
decision_needed: Implement independent stages now; hold only final scientific branches awaiting author choices.
availability_notes: This is a new integration task, not an existing working top-level pipeline. Stage implementation can proceed in parallel with per-figure recovery.

purpose: Freeze statistical designs and export auditable test inputs/results.
actions: Prepare observation tables with dataset, input/library, replicate, barcode/cell, pairing/block identifiers and all denominators.
Resolve D03-D06: Figure 4 paired/repeated tests, Figure 6 factor/replication structure, LR-Split-seq paired-test discrepancy, and Figure 2/3 nested observations and multiplicity.
Locate and preserve executed test records; if absent, label recomputation. Do not treat a legend label as proof.
After design selection, regenerate tests and update corresponding figure annotations, Methods, Results and rebuttal consistently.
validation: No count-vector-based inferred historical RAGE barcode identity is used for paired testing.
Test names, n, pairing, correction family and P values agree across code, tables and prose.
Barcode/read/technical-library counts are not silently treated as independent biological replicates.
decision_needed: Author decisions D03-D06 required for final test selection; prepare complete reviewable tables/proposals first.
availability_notes: Existing figure comments contain unresolved alternatives; descriptive source tables can be regenerated while these decisions are pending.

purpose: Integrate final figures and reconcile Methods, Results, legends and rebuttal with evidence.
actions: Use one selected validated source for each current panel and export plot tables with row keys and transformations.
Native Prism reopen/recalculation/export must verify editable files and cached analysis results; array/ZIP checks alone are insufficient.
Apply accepted Methods refinements newer than manuscript v3, remove Figure 8 material, replace stale Figure 7A/C, and correct units/data source descriptions.
Map each quantitative manuscript/rebuttal claim to a result key and denominator; document changed numbers and reasons.
Leave Figure 7E explicit until D07 is resolved. Preserve author working documents; make a new dated revision.
validation: All completed panels have a source-data table and editable/scripted renderer.
No unsupported biological-origin labels remain in Failure Mode 1/2.
Figure 1D uses 16 micrometre bins; Figure 4 SeqKit metrics are described as the actual long-read input measurements.
Every final claim traces to selected analysis; artwork labels and numerical tables agree.
decision_needed: D07 and D08 govern pending 7E and final artwork selection; settled definitions/scope need no reconfirmation.
public_outputs: editable figure files and final PDF/SVG/PNG exports
availability_notes: Most recent paragraph changes were made in conversation and are not all in the frozen v3 DOCX. Figure 2 Prism copy awaits native app validation.

purpose: Demonstrate reproducibility in a clean HPC environment and report each level separately.
actions: Render all completed panels from release C6 source tables without raw data or author-specific directories.
Rebuild source tables from each earliest valid retained checkpoint and compare identities, counts, statistics and plotting inputs.
Validate raw-to-checkpoint workflows where inputs are restored; report full run versus pilot versus unexecuted honestly.
Exercise input/configuration invalidation and representative duplicate/missing/orientation/segment edge cases.
Freeze expected counts from selected validated outputs; explain deviations rather than tuning outputs to match legacy claims.
validation: Independent reports distinguish render, resume and raw reproduction.
All required validators pass or an explicit unresolved exception is attached to the affected panel.
Clean build does not depend on unrecorded workspace objects or missing private helper scripts.
A full-data reproduction claim is supported by full-data execution and hashes.
decision_needed: Any scientifically changed result must be reviewed before replacing canonical manuscript values.
availability_notes: No full sequencing pipeline was run in the local audit. HPC resource allocations must be established from actual logs/pilots.

purpose: Prepare the revised GitHub and Zenodo release, metadata and publication handoff.
actions: Create current code/checkpoint/source-data archives with schemas and validated reproducibility instructions; retain an old-to-current artifact crosswalk.
Reconcile the preprint DOI appearing in Zenodo metadata against the README reserved DOI claim; prepare verified identifier/related-publication updates.
Update README, setup, CITATION, download instructions, Data Availability and rebuttal links from the same release registry.
Review derived-data redistribution, especially Engblom controlled-access inputs. Include authorized acquisition instructions rather than raw controlled reads.
Prepare creator, license, version, relation and artifact checksums; identify repository visibility required for public reproducibility. Stage upload-ready artifacts for author review.
validation: Release inventory covers all completed current panels and states pending/retired scope explicitly.
Every public artifact has a content hash, schema/format description and provenance.
No temporary private manuscript or unrelated legacy/controlled raw material enters the public archive inadvertently.
GitHub, manuscript and archival metadata use the same verified identifiers and version.
decision_needed: D08: author approval for actual publication, archive changes and repository visibility. Prepare everything reviewable first.
availability_notes: The private handoff ZIP is not the public deposition package; no publish/push/upload action is part of this local audit.
